slider.title: Your Modern Medical Practice Management Solution
slider.subtitle: TuniCare
slider.description: Streamline appointments, manage consultations, track exams, and generate medical reports effortlessly. Focus on patient care, let TuniCare handle the rest.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: TuniCare
about.description: TuniCare is a comprehensive platform designed to simplify the daily operations of medical practices. From scheduling appointments and managing patient records to handling consultations and generating detailed reports, our goal is to provide healthcare professionals with the tools they need to deliver efficient and effective care.

appointments.title: Appointment Scheduling
appointments.description: Easily book, reschedule, and manage patient appointments with our intuitive calendar system.

consultations.title: Consultation Management
consultations.description: Record consultation details, diagnoses, prescriptions, and follow-up plans efficiently.

exams.title: Exam Tracking
exams.description: Keep track of medical exams, results, and associated documents for each patient.

reports.title: Medical Reports
reports.description: Generate comprehensive medical reports and summaries with ease.

testimonial1Text: TuniCare has revolutionized how we manage our practice. Scheduling is a breeze, and accessing patient records is faster than ever. Highly recommended!
testimonial2Text: The consultation management features are fantastic. It helps us keep track of everything efficiently and improves patient follow-up.
testimonial3Text: Generating reports used to take hours, now it's just a few clicks. A real time-saver for our administrative staff!

footer.newsText: Subscribe to our newsletter for the latest updates and features.
